SourceNormalCone.statement: def SourceNormalCone (V : Set E) (x : E) : Set E

indicator_subdifferential_eq_normalCone.statement: theorem indicator_subdifferential_eq_normalCone [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (V : Set E) (hVn : V.Nonempty) (hVc : Convex ℝ V) (x : E) : SourceSubdifferential (extendedIndicator V) x = SourceNormalCone V x

normalCone_interior_eq_zero.statement: theorem normalCone_interior_eq_zero [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (V : Set E) (hVn : V.Nonempty) (hVc : Convex ℝ V) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ interior V) : SourceNormalCone V x = {(0 : E)}

normalCone_unitBall_boundary.statement: theorem normalCone_unitBall_boundary [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (x : E) (hx : ‖x‖ = 1) : SourceNormalCone {y : E | ‖y‖ ≤ 1} x = {g | ∃ α : ℝ, 0 ≤ α ∧ g = α • x}
